name: Bathymetric Survey
description: Auto-filled bathymetry report. Section content is baked into bathymetry_reports.sections by services/report_builder.py; the client renderer iterates and dispatches on `type`.

section_types.cover: Title block: report code, site, classification, model, timestamp.
section_types.raster: Depth product thumbnail + depth colour-bar legend: { raster_id, url, max_depth_m, caption }.
section_types.chart: Inline SVG cross-section: { profile: { distance_m[], depth_m[] } }.
section_types.stats: Stat tiles: { stats: { min_m, max_m, mean_m, std_m, coverage_pct } }.
